name: Build a spiral staircase
description: A tight spiral staircase winding around a central pillar, each step rotated 30 degrees from the last. Space-efficient vertical traversal with decorative railing.
luau_source:
-- Spiral Staircase — steps around a central pillar
local function buildSpiralStairs(center, steps)
  local model = Instance.new("Model")
  model.Name = "SpiralStairs"
  local angleStep = 30
  local stepHeight = 1.5
  local radius = 4
  for i = 0, steps - 1 do
    local angle = math.rad(i * angleStep)
    local step = Instance.new("Part")
    step.Name = "Step_" .. i
    step.Size = Vector3.new(radius * 2, 0.5, 3)
    step.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, i * stepHeight, math.sin(angle) * radius)) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
    step.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Steel blue")
    step.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    step.Anchored = true
    step.Parent = model
  end
  -- Central pillar
  local pillar = Instance.new("Part")
  pillar.Name = "CentralPillar"
  pillar.Size = Vector3.new(1, steps * stepHeight, 1)
  pillar.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, steps * stepHeight / 2, 0)
  pillar.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
  pillar.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  pillar.Anchored = true
  pillar.Parent = model
  return model
end
return buildSpiralStairs

name: Build a column row

luau_source:

  local model = Instance.new("Model")
  model.Name = "ColumnRow"
  for i = 0, count - 1 do

    local base = Instance.new("Part")

    base.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)

    base.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Marble")
    base.Material = Enum.Material.Marble
    base.Anchored = true
    base.Parent = model
    -- Shaft
    local shaft = Instance.new("Part")
    shaft.Name = "Shaft_" .. i
    shaft.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 16, 2.5)
    shaft.Position = Vector3.new(x, startPos.Y + 9, startPos.Z)
    shaft.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Marble")
    shaft.Material = Enum.Material.Marble
    shaft.Anchored = true
    shaft.Parent = model
    -- Capital

name: Build a chandelier
description: A hanging multi-candle chandelier suspended from the ceiling. Provides warm ambient lighting for great halls, dining rooms, and cathedrals.
luau_source:
-- Chandelier — hanging multi-light fixture
local function buildChandelier(anchorPos)
  local c = Instance.new("Model")
  c.Name = "Chandelier"
  -- Chain
  local chain = Instance.new("Part")
  chain.Name = "Chain"
  chain.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 8, 0.3)
  chain.Position = anchorPos - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
  chain.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
  chain.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  chain.Anchored = true
  chain.Parent = c
  -- Ring
  local ring = Instance.new("Part")
  ring.Name = "Ring"
  ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
  ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 10, 10)
  ring.Position = anchorPos - Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
  ring.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bronze")
  ring.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  ring.Anchored = true
  ring.Parent = c
  -- Candles (6 around ring)
  for i = 0, 5 do
    local angle = (i / 6) * math.pi * 2
    local cx = ring.Position.X + math.cos(angle) * 4.5
    local cz = ring.Position.Z + math.sin(angle) * 4.5
    local candle = Instance.new("Part")
    candle.Name = "Candle_" .. i
    candle.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 1.5, 0.5)
    candle.Position = Vector3.new(cx, ring.Position.Y + 0.5, cz)
    candle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
    candle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    candle.Anchored = true
    candle.Parent = c
    -- Flame light
    local flame = Instance.new("PointLight")
    flame.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)
    flame.Range = 12
    flame.Brightness = 2
    flame.Parent = candle
  end
  return c
end
return buildChandelier

  door.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
  door.Anchored = true
  door.Parent = w
  return w
end
return buildWindmill

name: Build a cargo crate stack
description: A scattered stack of wooden cargo crates in various sizes, perfect for dockyards, warehouses, and industrial zones. Adds clutter realism.
luau_source:
-- Cargo Crate Stack — scattered shipping crates
local function buildCrates(center, count)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "CrateStack"
  local colors = { "Rust", "Dark walnut", "Pine Cone", "Dark orange" }
  for i = 1, count do
    local size = 2 + math.random() * 3
    local crate = Instance.new("Part")
    crate.Name = "Crate_" .. i
    crate.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
    crate.Position = center + Vector3.new(
      (math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
      size / 2 + math.random(0, 2),
      (math.random() - 0.5) * 12
    )
    crate.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(colors[math.random(#colors)])
    crate.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    crate.Anchored = true
    crate.Parent = m
  end
  return m
end
return buildCrates

name: Build a pipe network
description: Industrial pipe segments with valves, joints, and gauges. Decorative infrastructure for factories, refineries, and steampunk environments.
luau_source:
-- Pipe Network — industrial conduits with valves
local function buildPipes(startPos, length)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "PipeNetwork"
  -- Horizontal pipe
  local pipe = Instance.new("Part")
  pipe.Name = "MainPipe"
  pipe.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
  pipe.Size = Vector3.new(length, 2, 2)
  pipe.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos + Vector3.new(length / 2, 8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
  pipe.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Rust")
  pipe.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  pipe.Anchored = true
  pipe.Parent = m
  -- Vertical drops every 8 studs
  for i = 0, math.floor(length / 8) do
    local drop = Instance.new("Part")
    drop.Name = "Drop_" .. i
    drop.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    drop.Size = Vector3.new(8, 1.5, 1.5)
    drop.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos + Vector3.new(i * 8, 4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
    drop.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
    drop.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    drop.Anchored = true
    drop.Parent = m
    -- Valve
    local valve = Instance.new("Part")
    valve.Name = "Valve_" .. i
    valve.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    valve.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5)
    valve.Position = startPos + Vector3.new(i * 8, 8, 0)
    valve.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    valve.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    valve.Anchored = true
    valve.Parent = m
  end
  return m
end
return buildPipes

name: Build a gear mechanism
description: Large decorative rotating gear assembly, steampunk aesthetic. Interlocking cog wheels that visually mesh. Pure decoration but adds industrial atmosphere.
luau_source:
-- Gear Mechanism — rotating interlocking cogs
local function buildGears(center)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "GearMechanism"
  local configs = {
    { radius = 8, pos = center, speed = 1 },
    { radius = 5, pos = center + Vector3.new(13, 3, 0), speed = -1.6 },
    { radius = 6, pos = center + Vector3.new(-11, -2, 0), speed = 1.3 },
  }
  for i, cfg in ipairs(configs) do
    -- Hub
    local hub = Instance.new("Part")
    hub.Name = "Hub_" .. i
    hub.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    hub.Size = Vector3.new(1, cfg.radius * 0.5, cfg.radius * 0.5)
    hub.Position = cfg.pos
    hub.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
    hub.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    hub.Anchored = true
    hub.Parent = m
    -- Teeth (8 around)
    for t = 0, 7 do
      local angle = (t / 8) * math.pi * 2
      local tooth = Instance.new("Part")
      tooth.Name = "Tooth_" .. i .. "_" .. t
      tooth.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 3, 1.5)
      tooth.CFrame = CFrame.new(cfg.pos + Vector3.new(0, math.cos(angle) * cfg.radius, math.sin(angle) * cfg.radius))
      tooth.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bronze")
      tooth.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
      tooth.Anchored = true
      tooth.Parent = m
    end
  end
  return m
end
return buildGears
